title: Low Fire Overlay
description: A sleek, PvP-focused resource pack featuring low fire to maximize your visibility in combat. Never let fire block your view during intense fights again!
body:
![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/099f77f6cc6c350fdb2739d4a64c285d08334b75.gif)
## 🔥 Overview

This is a lightweight, performance-focused resource pack designed specifically for **PvP and Bedwars** players. The primary goal of this pack is to improve your combat awareness by significantly reducing the height of the fire animation on your screen.

Say goodbye to massive flames blocking your view during intense fights!

---

## ✨ Features

* **Low Fire Animation:** Lowers the fire overlay on your screen so you can always track your opponents, even when you are burning.
* **Maximum Visibility:** Keeps the core gameplay elements clean and distraction-free.
* **FPS Friendly:** Uses optimized textures to ensure smooth performance during competitive gameplay.
